title: Registration and cancellation terms
body:
Current status of registration

The Orsini programme is in preparation. The form and payment run in a Stripe test environment: no real charges are made, no real place is reserved and no contract for a course is formed. Use only fictitious data and a test card.

What registration will include

Registration will include the sessions of the selected course and an associated book as a gift, which will be handed out at the first session. Each course page will state the dates, length, venue, teachers and materials for the call. The fee currently announced is an estimate; the final amount will be shown before any real payment.

Payment and confirmation

Stripe processes the payment on its secure page. Card details are not stored in the Orsini form. A registration will only be recorded as confirmed once the server has verified the payment. Returning to the website does not by itself confirm the registration.

Cancellations during testing

You can abandon or cancel the test payment at no cost. Temporary test reservations expire if the process is not completed. No refunds are needed because the test environment does not charge real amounts.

Before real sales open

The final call will set out the applicable cancellation, withdrawal and refund terms, any possible changes to or cancellation of the course, and how to request an invoice. This test form does not limit consumers’ statutory rights.

Enquiries

The project is run by Radical Books, Societat Cooperativa Catalana Limitada (Tax ID F10524965), registered at carrer Mestre Serradesanferm, 3, 08032 Barcelona. For registration enquiries: info@manifestllibres.cat.
